title: Water Rate Schedule — Utility Pass-Through Service Block Bounds, Block Rates and Water Base Charge
content:
Water on the Utility Pass-Through Service is measured in thousand gallons (kgal) per billing period. Each submetered schedule sets a fixed monthly water base charge, two block bounds and three block rates.

## Schedule of water figures

| Service schedule | Water base charge (USD per billing period) | First-block bound (kgal) | First-block rate (USD per kgal) | Second-block bound (kgal, from zero) | Second-block rate (USD per kgal) | Third-block rate (USD per kgal) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Flat-Rate Water, Sewer & Trash Schedule | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Submetered Water Schedule | 9.85 | 4.00 | 4.18 | 10.00 | 5.47 | 7.95 |
| Submetered Water & Sewer Schedule | 10.62 | 3.00 | 5.26 | 8.00 | 6.88 | 9.14 |
| Submetered Water, Sewer & Natural Gas Schedule | 11.20 | 3.00 | 4.92 | 8.00 | 6.31 | 8.47 |
| Submetered Water, Sewer & Propane Schedule | 10.40 | 3.00 | 5.61 | 8.00 | 7.02 | 9.36 |
| Submetered Electric, Water & Sewer Schedule | 8.75 | 5.00 | 3.87 | 12.00 | 5.12 | 7.40 |

Water is not submetered on the Flat-Rate Water, Sewer & Trash Schedule, so none of these figures applies there.

## Terms used in this schedule

- **Water base charge**: the fixed monthly water meter charge per site for the billing period.
- **First-block bound**: the upper bound of the first water rate block, in thousand gallons per billing period. The **first-block rate** applies to consumption within the first block.
- **Second-block bound**: the upper bound of the second water rate block, counted cumulatively from zero rather than from the first-block bound. The **second-block rate** applies to consumption above the first block up to the second-block bound.
- **Third-block rate**: the rate for consumption above the second-block bound.

## Notes on reading the bounds

Because the second-block bound is counted from zero, the width of the second block is the second-block bound less the first-block bound. Worked from the table (illustration only):

| Service schedule | First block covers | Second block covers | Third block covers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Submetered Water Schedule | 0 to 4.00 kgal | above 4.00 up to 10.00 kgal (6.00 kgal wide) | above 10.00 kgal |
| Submetered Water & Sewer, Natural Gas and Propane Schedules | 0 to 3.00 kgal | above 3.00 up to 8.00 kgal (5.00 kgal wide) | above 8.00 kgal |
| Submetered Electric, Water & Sewer Schedule | 0 to 5.00 kgal | above 5.00 up to 12.00 kgal (7.00 kgal wide) | above 12.00 kgal |

**Does the water base charge depend on consumption?** No. It is a fixed monthly figure per site and is listed separately from the block rates.
